# 7. Shrink the failing case to a minimal example — delete code until the bug either vanishes (scope it) or becomes obvious (isolate it).

# 9. Add assert statements for invariants (e.g., assert len(rows) == expected) so corrupted state surfaces at the corruption point, not downstream.
# 10. Write a failing unit test that captures the bug before fixing it; the test proves the fix and guards against regression later.
